text:
A builder in Rockingham has been meaning to set up his Google Business Profile since June.

He's read four guides on it. Watched two YouTube videos.

Profile still not set up.

It takes an afternoon. Stop reading about it. Pick a day this week and do it.

Let AI write your Google review replies and every reply comes out the same polite paragraph.

Give it the details instead. Name, job, suburb. "Thanks Dave, glad the hot water's sorted in Kingsley."

Google shows your replies under your reviews. New customers read them. Make each one sound like you.

Most people don't book the first time they search.

Someone in Duncraig looks up new deadlocks in March, gets a quote and sits on it.

Your ad follows them on YouTube and Facebook for a few weeks.

When they're finally ready to book, yours is the name they already know.
